verdict.rationale: SumUp documents a public API in depth. It covers API-key authorization, checkout creation, full and partial refunds, and the Cloud API for driving Solo readers over HTTPS, all wrapped by an official TypeScript SDK and exposed through a managed MCP server and llms.txt docs. A community developer independently built an integration on the public API. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found at the probed paths.
